name: How long does it take to build a tiny home suitable for rental purposes?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a tiny home suitable for rental purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a tiny home depends on its size, complexity, and whether it's a custom build or a pre-designed model. Typically, the build process for a high-quality tiny home, suitable for rental, can range from 3 to 6 months from initial design to completion. This does not include the time required for permitting and site preparation, which can add several weeks or even a few months. Zen Tiny Homes works efficiently to deliver homes within reasonable timeframes, coordinating with our clients throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a rental-ready tiny home usually takes 3-6 months. This excludes permitting and site prep, which can add more time.
